about: Storage layouts of TAP-draft-proof-verified-reads §7 on live chains, recorded read-only on 2026-09-30 at a block pinned as TAP-10 §5.3 specifies (the second-highest operator head minus 2; `pinLag` as defined there), with the header (hash, stateRoot) reported identically by two operators. For each chain: `inputs`; the slots §7 computes from them (`slots`, normative: every implementation must compute the same); the eth_getProof answers (`accounts`), which checked against `block.stateRoot` (§6) must give exactly `expect`; the layout gates of §7 (`gates`, each must hold for the layout to apply); `decoded`, the values §7 and §8 derive from the proven words; and `reads`, the eth_call answers at the same block, which `decoded` must equal (§8).
